prospective_simulation.note: Only 3 exploratory unit-test attempts in ledger, all exited early by operator. Zero completed TP/SL trades.

denominator_accounting_defect_repaired.prior_v32_43_behavior: Included USER_EXITED_EARLY in denominator of strategy rule success rate
denominator_accounting_defect_repaired.v32_44_repaired_behavior: Strictly restricts denominator to eligible completed attempts (TP, SL, Anomaly, Timeout). Reports pending, user-exited, unresolved, and partial separately.

seven_of_ten_rule_audit.epistemic_uncertainty_statement: Passing 7/10 is an eligibility screen, NOT proof of a future 70% success probability. Under binomial assumptions, Wilson 95% CI is [39.7%, 89.2%]. Financial time-series serial dependence expands true uncertainty further.

tournament_validity_audit.selection_rule: Candidate qualifies IF AND ONLY IF it passes 7/10 screen, achieves positive AI lift over strategy alone, AND beats matched baseline comparator.
tournament_validity_audit.all_candidates_failing_behavior: Produces ABSTAIN. Being the highest-ranked candidate is not sufficient if all candidates fail.
tournament_validity_audit.intrabar_dual_touch_handling: Flagged as UNRESOLVED_INTRABAR_ORDER without tick feed evidence.
tournament_validity_audit.calibration_claim_audit: Candidate setup explicitly marked NOT_CALIBRATED. Directional forecast probability explicitly separated from TP-first target probability.

defect_repair_ledger.description: Duplicate entry requests created duplicate attempts due to timestamp inclusion in attempt hash without active attempt check.
defect_repair_ledger.remediation: Implemented idempotency keying and active trade verification by (strategy_id, tournament_id). Duplicate requests now idempotently return existing active trade.

defect_repair_ledger.description: Evaluation summary denominator included USER_EXITED_EARLY attempts in automated TP-first hit rate.
defect_repair_ledger.remediation: Restricted denominator strictly to eligible completed attempts (TP_HIT, SL_HIT, EXITED_ANOMALY, TIMEOUT_NO_TP). Pending, user-exited, unresolved, and partial are reported separately.

defect_repair_ledger.description: update_active_attempts completely omitted checking for qualifying anomaly exits.
defect_repair_ledger.remediation: Added anomaly trigger evaluation in update_active_attempts and dedicated trigger_anomaly_exit method.

defect_repair_ledger.description: Tournament winner selection used arbitrary hardcoded threshold (> 0.52) rather than testing positive AI lift and beating matched baseline comparator.
defect_repair_ledger.remediation: Replaced with strict 3-arm improvement rule: candidate must pass 7/10 screen, achieve positive AI lift over strategy alone, and beat baseline comparator, or ABSTAIN.

defect_repair_ledger.description: post_enter_simulated_trade allowed entry when market data was unavailable (e.g. entry price <= 0) or when decision status was not SMART_ENTRY_AVAILABLE.
defect_repair_ledger.remediation: Added validation blocking entry if decision is not SMART_ENTRY_AVAILABLE or if live market price is unavailable.

defect_repair_ledger.description: MarketRegimeClassifier raised KeyError if close/high/low columns were absent in DataFrame.
defect_repair_ledger.remediation: Added required columns verification returning UNKNOWN_OR_INVALID on missing columns.
